description: SQLAlchemy InvalidRequestError: Multiple classes found for path 'Vendor' in declarative base, breaking 50 unit tests
root_cause: Duplicate Vendor class declaration across core.models.assets and core.modules.vendor_risk.models
resolution: Unified all Vendor columns on core.models.assets.Vendor and re-exported Vendor in core.modules.vendor_risk.models

description: PostgreSQL-only interval syntax ('current_date - interval 30 days') caused SQLite test failures
root_cause: Raw SQL used PostgreSQL interval literal instead of parameterized cutoff date
resolution: Replaced interval literals with Python-computed parameterized start_date (:start_date) compatible with both PostgreSQL and SQLite

description: Hardcoded /Users/iceman/Documents/Code/Kibo paths broke URI resolution and test_suite.py
root_cause: Legacy developer machine path hardcoded in 8 files
resolution: Replaced all hardcoded paths with dynamic Path(__file__).resolve() workspace root resolution and created .gitkeep in .kibo/state/{clients,deployments,proof}

description: GDPR Art. 3 negative test (Test 9) initially allowed EU-HR-GDPR-IMPL and exempted EU-GDPR on fine ceiling thresholds
root_cause: National GDPR packs matched 'GDPR' substring when gdpr=False, and statutory fine ceiling thresholds were evaluated as applicability gates
resolution: Restricted non-EU Art. 3 exempt outcome to EU-GDPR only when gdpr=False and excluded fine/penalty/minor_age/employee_count metrics from universal applicability threshold gating

description: NY SHIELD Act and NY Breach notification rules were marked entity-exempt for financial institutions in Test 2
root_cause: NY SHIELD substituted compliance note was modeled as an entity_level exemption
resolution: Updated engine.py to treat 'deemed compliant' / 'may still apply' exemptions as substituted-compliance review notes rather than full exclusions

description: gemma4:26b on DGX Spark returned empty response string when num_predict was 220
root_cause: Ollama gemma4:26b defaults to thinking tokens consuming token budget unless think=False is set
resolution: Set think=False and num_predict=512 in dgx_evaluator.py; 5/5 scenarios passed in 27.28s
Subset of secondary state/provincial/national opening-clause pinpoint citations flagged with LegalReviewStatus.REQUIRES_COUNSEL_SIGNOFF
status: Per Section 3.3 and Section 13, LLM-authored or secondary national citations must not be marked counsel-verified without human legal review
requires_counsel_signoff: Preserved LegalReviewStatus.REQUIRES_COUNSEL_SIGNOFF on those specific rules so JRAE surfaces requires_legal_review=True for human counsel sign-off
